ns2:course.label: Greenhouse Mgmt and Production
ns2:course.description: Survey of topics relating to commercial greenhouse operations, management, and production. Examines design, location, and glazing of greenhouse structures; greenhouse operations such as heating, cooling, environmental control, and irrigation systems; production factors including light, temperature, root media, fertilization, watering, and integrated pest management; and management concepts such as industry trends and cost analysis. Production of fall potted crops will be emphasized. Prerequisite: NRES 201and HORT 100.
